lines.t: As the quiet settles in, and the world grows still again
I feel your mercy like the dawn, a gentle whisper leading on
The noise fades out, Your peace remains
A healing river through my veins
In all my weakness, You are strong
In Sabbath rest, I still belong
You gather every broken part
You breathe Your life into my heart
Sabbath rest, I breathe You in
Wash my soul and cleanse my sin
Let Your love renew my mind
A holy peace I only find in You
Yahushua, draw me near
Let Your presence calm my fear
In Your light my worries fade
In Your arms I am remade
The weight I carry through the week
You lift it gently when I see
Your kindness meets me where I am
A shepherd calling to his lamb
You teach my restless heart to stay
To trust your voice, to walk your way
In sacred stillness I am found
Your Sabbath blessing all around
You gather every broken part You breathe Your life into my heart
Sabbath rest, I breathe You in Wash my soul and cleanse my sin
Let Your love renew my mind A holy peace I only find in You
Yahushua, draw me near, let Your presence calm my fear
In Your light my worries fade, in Your arms I am remade
Here in the quiet, You speak softly
Calling my soul to rise again
Your peace surrounds me like a blanket
Your love restores me from within
You are my refuge, my delight
My Sabbath flame, my guiding light
Sabbath rest I breathe you in
Where Your mercy never ends
Every tear You wash away
Every burden You replace with peace
Yahushua, hold me close
You're the only one I know
In Your light my heart is free
Sabbath rest is here with me
Thanks for watching!
